2: name: openai-whisper-api

24: ---
25: 
26: # OpenAI transcriptions API
27: 
28: Transcribe audio through `/v1/audio/transcriptions`. Set `OPENAI_BASE_URL` for an OpenAI-compatible proxy or local gateway.
29: 
30: ## Quick start
31: 
32: ```bash
33: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a
34: ```
35: 
36: Defaults:
37: 
38: - Model: `gpt-4o-transcribe`
39: - Output: `<input>.txt`
40: 
41: ## Useful flags
42: 
43: ```bash
44: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model gpt-4o-transcribe --out /tmp/transcript.txt
45: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
46: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize --json
47: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model whisper-1
48: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --language en
49: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --prompt "Speaker names: Peter, Daniel"
50: {baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --json --out /tmp/transcript.json
51: ```
52: 
53: Notes:
54: 
55: - Supported upload formats include `mp3`, `mp4`, `mpeg`, `mpga`, `m4a`, `wav`, `webm`.
56: - 25 MB upload limit on the hosted API.
57: - Use diarize for speaker labels; script sends `chunking_strategy=auto` and rejects `--prompt`.
58: 
59: ## API key
60: 
61: Set `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or configure it in the active OpenClaw config file (`$OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`, default `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`). Optionally set `OPENAI_BASE_URL`:
62: 
63: ```json5
64: {
65:   skills: {
66:     "openai-whisper-api": {
67:       apiKey: "OPENAI_KEY_HERE",
68:     },
69:   },
70: }
71: ```", "scripts/transcribe.sh": "1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: set -euo pipefail
3: 
4: usage() {
5:   cat >&2 <<'EOF'
6: Usage:
7:   transcribe.sh <audio-file> [--model gpt-4o-transcribe] [--out /path/to/out.txt] [--language en] [--prompt "hint"] [--json]
8: EOF
9:   exit 2
10: }
11: 
12: if [[ "${1:-}" == "" || "${1:-}" == "-h" || "${1:-}" == "--help" ]]; then
13:   usage
14: fi
15: 
16: in="${1:-}"
17: shift || true
18: 
19: model="gpt-4o-transcribe"
20: out=""
21: language=""
22: prompt=""
23: json_output=0
24: 
25: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
26:   case "$1" in
27:     --model)
28:       model="${2:-}"
29:       shift 2
30:       ;;
31:     --out)
32:       out="${2:-}"
33:       shift 2
34:       ;;
35:     --language)
36:       language="${2:-}"
37:       shift 2
38:       ;;
39:     --prompt)
40:       prompt="${2:-}"
41:       shift 2
42:       ;;
43:     --json)
44:       json_output=1
45:       shift 1
46:       ;;
47:     *)
48:       echo "Unknown arg: $1" >&2
49:       usage
50:       ;;
51:   esac
52: done
53: 
54: if [[ ! -f "$in" ]]; then
55:   echo "File not found: $in" >&2
56:   exit 1
57: fi
58: 
59: if [[ "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" == "" ]]; then
60:   echo "Missing OPENAI_API_KEY" >&2
61:   exit 1
62: fi
63: 
64: if [[ "$out" == "" ]]; then
65:   base="${in%.*}"
66:   if [[ "$json_output" == "1" ]]; then
67:     out="${base}.json"
68:   else
69:     out="${base}.txt"
70:   fi
71: fi
72: 
73: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
74: 
75: api_base="${OPENAI_BASE_URL:-https://api.openai.com/v1}"
76: api_base="${api_base%/}"
77: 
78: request_format="text"
79: if [[ "$json_output" == "1" ]]; then
80:   request_format="json"
81: fi
82: 
83: diarize=0
84: case "$model" in
85:   gpt-4o-transcribe | gpt-4o-mini-transcribe | gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-*)
86:     request_format="json"
87:     ;;
88:   gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize)
89:     diarize=1
90:     request_format="diarized_json"
91:     ;;
92: esac
93: 
94: if [[ "$diarize" == "1" && "$prompt" != "" ]]; then
95:   echo "--prompt is not supported with gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize" >&2
96:   exit 2
97: fi
98: 
99: target="$out"
100: tmp=""
101: if [[ "$json_output" == "0" && ( "$request_format" == "json" || "$request_format" == "diarized_json" ) ]]; then
102:   tmp="$(mktemp)"
103:   trap '[[ "$tmp" == "" ]] || rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
104:   target="$tmp"
105: fi
106: 
107: curl_args=(
108:   -sS "${api_base}/audio/transcriptions"
109:   -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY"
110:   -H "Accept: application/json"
111:   -F "file=@${in}"
112:   -F "model=${model}"
113:   -F "response_format=${request_format}"
114: )
115: if [[ "$language" != "" ]]; then
116:   curl_args+=(-F "language=${language}")
117: fi
118: if [[ "$prompt" != "" ]]; then
119:   curl_args+=(-F "prompt=${prompt}")
120: fi
121: if [[ "$diarize" == "1" ]]; then
122:   curl_args+=(-F "chunking_strategy=auto")
123: fi
124: 
125: curl "${curl_args[@]}" >"$target"
126: 
127: if [[ "$target" != "$out" ]]; then
128:   node -e '
129: const fs = require("fs");
130: const input = process.argv[1];
131: const output = process.argv[2];
132: const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(input, "utf8"));
133: if (Array.isArray(payload.segments)) {
134:   const lines = payload.segments
135:     .map((segment) => {
136:       const text = typeof segment?.text === "string" ? segment.text.trim() : "";
137:       if (!text) return "";
138:       const speaker = typeof segment?.speaker === "string" ? segment.speaker.trim() : "";
139:       return speaker ? `${speaker}: ${text}` : text;
140:     })
141:     .filter(Boolean);
142:   if (lines.length > 0) {
143:     fs.writeFileSync(output, lines.join("\n"));
144:     process.exit(0);
145:   }
146: }
147: if (typeof payload.text !== "string") {
148:   throw new Error("Transcription response missing text");
149: }
150: fs.writeFileSync(output, payload.text);
151: ' "$target" "$out"
152: fi
153: 
154: echo "$out""}}
